description: data/download.json: the desktop version blowhorn.ai downloads. This repository also publishes blowhorn-axi releases (tags axi-vX.Y.Z), and GitHub's 'latest' release is whichever stable release was created most recently, so /releases/latest/download/Blowhorn-mac.dmg resolves to an axi release and 404s whenever one is newer. Every download URL on the site is therefore built from this pinned version, the newest vX.Y.Z desktop release; bump it in the same pass that publishes a desktop release (docs/distribution.md).

version.description: The newest published desktop release, without the leading v: tag v<version> exists on this repository and carries Blowhorn-mac.dmg and SHA256SUMS.txt.

title: Current desktop release
